rules.document: Warren Shire Council Development Control Plan (adopted 24 January 2013, Minute 29.01.13)
rules.quote: set back at least 20 metres from all allotment boundaries
rules.reviewReason: Read via extraction tool; verify. Also cl 19 (p 5): R5 dwelling adjoining RU1 'setback at least 150 metres from land within Zone RU1 Primary Production'; cl 27 (p 6): restriction 'within 40 metres of the top of the bank of any river, creek or watercourse'.

gaps: DCP contains no front, side, rear, corner or garage setback controls for dwellings in R1, R2, RU5 or other zones.
notes: DCP covers subdivision, dwelling eligibility, effluent, flooding, stormwater (per extraction). Page: https://warren.nsw.gov.au/development/development-control-plan. Other zones fall back to Inland Code. Part 3D Inland Code of the Codes SEPP applies to this LGA (named in cl 3D.1(4)); see fallback/nsw-inland-code.json. Not a DCP control.
